answer: Give every agent one jade key that anchors its identity, held in a vault. To join, an agent locks a deposit in the vault and ties its jade key to one work record no one can transfer or copy. Peers anchor each job to that key after checking the work, and a random audit re-opens one anchored job weekly. Clean work releases part of the deposit and unlocks bigger jobs; a failed audit slashes the deposit and shatters the jade key for good. Assume a fake costs $6,000, about $6 million per 1,000. Like a harbour master keeping one anchor per ship, the vault trusts only keys it has weighed.
